title: tanacetum balsamita var. balsamitoides
intro: Tanacetum balsamita var. balsamitoides, commonly known as Balsam Tansy, is a perennial herb belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of menopausal hot flashes, as well as its antiseptic and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Balsam Tansy include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and sedative effects, which contribute to its use in treating anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Balsam Tansy include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
